text: Figure 6.3: AUTOSAR Layered Architecture Class CommConnectorPort (abstract) Note The Ecu communication relationship defines which signals, Pdus and frames are actually received and transmitted by this ECU. For each signal, Pdu or Frame that is transmitted or received and used by the Ecu an association between an ISignalPort, IPduPort or FramePort with the corresponding T riggering shall be created. An ISignalPort shall be created only if the corresponding signal is handled by COM (RTE or Signal Gateway). If a Pdu Gateway ECU only routes the Pdu without being interested in the content only a FramePort and an IPduPort needs to be created.
